title: Bauhaus Constructivism to Design Tokens
discipline: Bauhaus Functionalism · Design Token Architecture · Mathematical Geometric Ratios · Modern Scalability
hypothesis: Can the radical functionalist ethos of the Bauhaus (Herbert Bayer, El Lissitzky)—reducing form to pure geometric primitives and primary colors—be re-engineered as the foundational ontology for modern scalable Design System Tokens and atomic UI frameworks?
